column1: # STATUS: LIVE, 2026-11-17. Case table of the FFmpeg NVENC/NVDEC capability matrix row (docs/design/V3_OPEN_ROWS_FFMPEG_DCGM.md).
# One case per line, tab separated. `needs` is the condition under which the case is EXPECTED to work, written over what the driver
# itself reports (nvcodec_probe.c); it is never a per-die table. Grammar: scripts/apps/open_rows/nvcodec_lib.py parse_needs.
# A case whose needs fail is still run: it must fail (NOT_SUPPORTED); an unexpected success is a MISMATCH.
